extDescription.message: Updates your Cinepisode progress while you watch Netflix (diagnostics on Prime Video, Disney+, Max and Crunchyroll).

optionsIntro.message: Generate this token in Cinepisode: Settings › Auto-tracking (Netflix, Plex...) › Generate my token (the same token works for Tautulli and this extension). Paste it below.

coverage.message: Currently supported: Netflix only. Open the console (F12) on a /watch/ page to see what the extension detects.
